summary_en: Kawasaki Kisen completed cancellation of 44,429,000 shares on October 2, 2026, representing 6.95% of issued shares before cancellation. Post-cancellation issued shares total 594,743,067.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Share Cancellation
translation_en_brief:
Kawasaki Kisen completed the cancellation of 44,429,000 ordinary shares of the company on October 2, 2026, pursuant to a Board of Directors resolution dated September 25, 2026. The cancelled shares represented 6.95% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock) prior to cancellation.

The shares cancelled were those acquired under a separate buyback programme authorized by the Board on May 29, 2026. The acquisition phase concluded on September 18, 2026, with 44,429,000 shares purchased—the full upper limit—at an authorized expenditure of up to 130 billion yen via ToSTNeT-3 (off-market trading) and market purchases between June 1 and September 30, 2026. Following completion of the acquisition, the Board resolved on September 25, 2026 to cancel all acquired treasury shares.

Post-cancellation, the company's issued share count (excluding treasury stock) stands at 594,743,067 shares. Remaining treasury stock, excluding shares held by the employee stock purchase trust (BBT), totals 1,114,598 shares.
